headlines.text: Fed's Oct. 27-28 meeting minutes due out this afternoon (2pm ET), expected to detail the 10-2 vote to hold rates at 3.75%-4%, with Cook and Hammack's dissents favoring a hike underscoring little room for a December cut
Anthropic set to price its IPO Wednesday evening at $70-$78 a share, valuing the AI firm near $1.4 trillion ahead of Thursday's Nasdaq debut under ticker ANT
Target reports fiscal Q3 results before the bell today, with Wall Street eyeing EPS near $2.07 on ~$26.5B revenue as the stock heads into earnings up roughly 70% this year

Nvidia posted fiscal Q3 revenue of $115.8B (up 103% YoY, crushing the ~$109B estimate) with EPS of $2.70 and guided Q4 to $130B in interim CEO Colette Kress's first earnings call since Jensen Huang's exit; shares surged nearly 4% after hours

Dow sank 1.64% (848 points) to a 1.5-month low, the S&P 500 fell 1% to a five-month low, and the Nasdaq dropped for a fourth straight session Tuesday as Wall Street digested Nvidia's earnings and October retail sales
U.S. retail sales growth slowed to 0.2% in October from September's 0.8%, though core sales excluding autos, gas and building materials rose a stronger-than-expected 0.6%
